title: Cache-hit causal attribution and explainability probe
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Objective: build an automated probe and attribution pipeline that links distribution of KV/prefix cache hits to specific semantic deltas in model outputs, and produce human-readable explanations for why a cache hit changed output quality. This will be used as a gating signal for rollouts and for post-rollback RCA.
acceptance_criteria: Probe produces per-request attribution: whether a hit/non-hit caused any token-level or semantic change
Quantitative summary metrics (hit-induced BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim delta) computed across corpora and stratified by latency buckets
Explainability component generates a concise rationale (1-3 sentences) pointing at probable cache-warmed context tokens or KV corruption scenarios
Dashboard with time-series of hit-attributed regressions and alerting rules (threshold-based + statistically significant shifts)
Can be run as part of pre-rollout shadow-eval and in live sampling mode without exceeding 5% of production RPS
steps: Design data collection hook to capture paired responses (with and without simulated cache hits) at sampling points
Implement lightweight in-server simulator that can toggle KV reuse per-request and emit diff signatures
Develop semantic delta scorer using embedding-based similarity and targeted n-gram diffs for short-form responses
Prototype explainability heuristics: token provenance tracing + attention-weighted mismatch indicators
Integrate outputs into Console as a new 'Cache Attribution' pane and wire to existing alerting
Run a 2-week shadow-eval across 10k representative prompts and compare against golden-responses
Iterate on thresholds and false-positive rate with PM/QA feedback
notes: 2025-02-15: Spike completed — can toggle KV reuse via header flag; saw 0.7% of sampled responses with token-level changes when enabling prefix cache on long prompts
Trade-off: full replay (rerun from scratch) provides ground truth but is expensive; using in-server deterministic toggle reduces cost but may miss cross-request nondeterminism
Design decision: prioritize embedding-similarity + top-token diffs over BLEU for better semantic sensitivity on short completions (PM feedback)
Review: UX prototype reviewed by Lara Patel (Design) on 2025-02-22 — asked for compact summaries and clear action buttons (rollback/canary)
Follow-up: add provenance ID to logs to trace back into GPU execution traces when explainability indicates kernel mis-selection
Open question: acceptable alert volume — propose initial threshold of 0.25% hit-attributed regressions with 7-day rolling baseline
tests: Unit: simulate KV-on/KV-off for deterministic small models
Integration: shadow-eval harness across staging cluster with 10k prompts
Regression: flag historical builds and run attribution to confirm zero-shot false-positive rate < 0.5%
Load: verify sampling hook at 5% RPS does not increase p95 latency by >2%
rollout_plan: Alpha in staging (1 week) -> Shadow in canary region (2 weeks) -> Gradual onboard to Console for opt-in customers -> Default alerting enabled after 2 successful canary cycles
